text:
Ravi: quick brainstorm 9: we need a 4-email reactivation drip for trial users who started but didn't convert. primary goals: reopen product, drive webinar regs, capture demo interest.
Nora: yes. cohort = trials started >=30 days ago AND last_active between 7-30 days, exclude unsubscribed. small cohort tuned for deliverability.
Vik: suggested cadence: day 0 invite (soft ask), day 3 social proof + short case study, day 7 urgency/offer, day 14 last-chance + replay. all with low-friction CTAs.
Dee: subject direction: "We fixed inference bottlenecks that slowed your tests" vs "Your trial is ready for another spin 1". keep under 60 chars.
Ravi: Also plan a micro A/B: subject variant vs CTA destination (direct login vs webinar reg). track sign-ins and demo request tag.
Nora: Segment queries for DF:
SELECT email FROM users WHERE trial_started <= now() - interval '30 days' AND last_active BETWEEN now() - interval '30 days' AND now() - interval '7 days' AND unsubscribed = false AND email_verified = true;
Vik: suppression: exclude previous_react_emails.opt_out and partner_contacts. also exclude hard bounces.
Dee: copy notes: short intro, 1 screenshot, 2 CTAs (Resume trial | Book a demo). add dynamic snippet for dedicated customers: "Ask your AE about reserved capacity".
MailerBot: preview: https://staging.redwood.ai/reactivate/1771239876. seeds passed.
Ravi: deliverability plan: ramp 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 12h. add seed list of 80. monitor spam complaints, unsub rates, and 24h heated complaints threshold at 0.06%.
Nora: UTM: utm_campaign=trial_reactivate_q2, utm_medium=email, utm_content={segment}_{variant}. event tags: nl_open, nl_click, nl_resume, nl_demo.
Vik: QA checklist: inbox render, link validation, alt text, text-only fallback, preview text length. send final QA to deliverability by Wed noon.
Dee: timeline: copy Tue EOD, creative Wed, DF pull Wed night, QA Thu, ramp Fri.
Ravi: ok locking plan. Nora please paste cohort counts in thread when DF run completes.
Nora: will run and post counts.
MailerBot: campaign job queued (id 7243).
